title: Ares complains; Zeus rebukes him
intro: Ares complains to Zeus. Zeus rebukes his love of conflict and compares his temper to Hera's.

notes.text: φαίνομαι, appear: 3sg impf, φαίνετο; completes the preceding simile. ὁμοῦ + dat, together with the clouds.
καρπαλίμως, swiftly; ἱκάνω, reach: unaugmented 3sg impf.
ἕδος, seat / abode (neut); αἰπύς, steep / lofty: acc masc sg with Olympus.
πάρ = παρά, beside; καθέζομαι, sit down: 3sg impf. ἀχεύω, grieve: pres ptc; θυμόν acc of respect, “grieving at heart.”
ἄμβροτος, immortal; καταρρέω, flow down: pres ptc acc neut sg with blood.
ὠτειλή, wound: gen sg after ἐκ.
ὀλοφύρομαι, lament / complain: pres mid ptc; προσαυδάω, address: 3sg impf.
νεμεσίζομαι, feel indignation: 2sg pres mid; repeats Hera's opening question at 757.
ῥίγιστος, most dreadful / chilling: acc neut pl, “the most dreadful things,” object of endurance.
τλάω / τέτληκα, endure: perf act ptc nom pl + epic εἰμέν = ἐσμέν; “we have endured.”
ἰότης, will / purpose: dat sg of cause, “through one another's designs.”
“Doing favours for [men]”; χάριν φέρω + dat, gratify / oblige.
σοί dat, “we are all at odds with you”; μαχόμεσθα = μαχόμεθα. τίκτω, beget: unaugmented 2sg 2aor.
ἄφρων, senseless / reckless: acc fem sg; κούρη, daughter; οὐλομένην, accursed / destructive, aor mid ptc form of ὄλλυμι used adjectivally.
ἀήσυλος, outrageous / lawless; μέλω, be a concern: 3sg perf act + dat ᾗ, Athena. Neut pl subject, sg verb.
ἐπιπείθομαι, obey: 3pl pres mid. δάμνημι, subdue: epic 1pl perf pass, “we are subject”; ἕκαστος distributes over “we,” each one.
ἔπος, word: dat sg; προτιβάλλομαι = προσβάλλομαι, oppose: uncontracted 2sg pres mid. “You oppose her neither in word nor deed.”
ἀνίημι, let loose / leave free: 2sg pres act; Athena is the object.
γείνομαι, beget: epic 2sg aor mid, -αο = -ω. ἀΐδηλος, destructive / annihilating, with παῖδα.
ὑπερφίαλος, overbearing / arrogant: acc sg, Ares' hostile description of Diomedes.
μαργαίνω, rage madly: pres inf; ἀνίημι, let loose: 3sg aor, epic uncontracted form. “Unleashed him to rage against the gods.”
Κύπρις, Aphrodite: acc sg. οὐτάω, wound: 3sg aor. καρπός, wrist: dat sg; χεῖρα, hand, acc of wounded part.
“He rushed at me myself”; ἐπισεύω, rush upon: 3sg aor mid; emphatic dat αὐτῷ μοι.
“Like a god”; δαίμων, divine power / god: dat sg after ἶσος.
ὑποφέρω, carry away / out of danger: epic 3pl aor act, stem ἐνεικ-; subject πόδες, feet.
πάσχω, suffer: 1sg impf with κε, unreal consequence, “otherwise I would have suffered long”; δηρόν, for a long time; αὐτοῦ, there.
πῆμα, misery / affliction: acc pl; νεκάς, heap of corpses: dat pl, epic -εσσι.
ζώς, alive; ἀμενηνός, strengthless; ἔα, epic 1sg impf of εἰμί with κε, “I would have been.” An immortal can be disabled, though not killed.
χαλκός gen sg, bronze [weapon]; τυπή, blow / stroke: dat pl, cause.
“Looking grimly / from under his brows”; ὑπόδρα adv.; εἶδον 2aor ptc nom sg.
ἀλλοπρόσαλλος, fickle: voc sg. παρέζομαι, sit beside: pres ptc. μινυρίζω, whine: 2sg pres imperative, negated.
Most hateful of the gods; superlative of ἐχθρός + partitive gen.
ἀάσχετος, unrestrainable; ἐπιεικτός, yielding / compliant, negated. Both with μένος, spirit / temper.
σπουδῇ, with difficulty; δάμνημι, subdue: 1sg pres act; ἔπος dat pl. “I can barely control her with words.”
ἐννεσίη, prompting / instigation: dat pl of cause; κείνης = ἐκείνης, Hera. Zeus attributes Ares' suffering to her urging.
